raw.details:
CODERED ’26 - National-Level Hackathon

CODERED ’26, organised by the Entrepreneurship Cell of BMS Institute of Technology and Management, Bengaluru, is a national-level hackathon designed to take student teams beyond from just solving a problem to building meaningful, functional products.

This edition brings together six participating companies, offering students the opportunity to work on real-world product ideas across multiple domains. 
Check out our WEBSITE for the Challenge Briefs.

Company Tracks:

CODERED ’26 features four tracks, with six participating companies:

Dedicated Company Tracks:

  • Niveus Technologies
  • Simple Energy
  • Agnes AI
  • XP Robotis
  • Unisys

Each of these companies will have a dedicated track featuring one or more product ideas for participating teams.

Startup Track:

The Startup Track brings together product opportunities from:

  • Think Robotics
  • Sahasranshu Technologies
  • MyStartupWave
  • Cassette Labs

The participating companies may provide multiple product ideas within their respective domains. Teams can explore the available ideas and select one product idea from one company to work on throughout the competition.

Teams are not required to work on every idea offered under a track.

Competition Structure:

CODERED ’26 will be conducted across three rounds, progressively taking teams from initial ideas to functional products.
Refer the BROCHURE for more information

Eligibility and Team Composition:

1. The participants should be currently pursuing engineering in any filed in a recognised institute.

2. Participants from different institutes can form a single team.

Participants are required to adhere to the team formation and eligibility conditions specified during registration.

Registration and Participation Guidelines:

  • Teams must complete the registration process through the official Unstop opportunity page.

  • Participants must submit their ideas in the prescribed format within the stipulated deadline.

  • Each team may select only one product idea from one participating company.

  • Teams must continue working on the product idea selected during the competition.

  • Teams are expected to develop their ideas into functional prototypes or MVPs during the product development journey.

  • All participants must comply with the competition guidelines and instructions issued by the organisers.

The CODERED ’26 Experience:

  • CODERED ’26 aims to provide students with an opportunity to experience the complete product development process while engaging with industry and emerging companies.
  • Through company-led product opportunities, structured evaluation rounds and an intensive offline 24 hour sprint, participants will get the opportunity to move beyond theoretical ideas and work towards building functional products.

The objective is simple: Take an idea, build it into a functional product, and demonstrate what it can achieve.
